questions.question: Indian Meteorological Department has officially marked which of the following as the warmest year in India since 1901?
The Scheme for Integrated Textile Parks (SITP), launched in 2005, primarily aims to:
options: Consolidate individual units in a cluster
Promote fragmentation in the textiles value chain
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Consolidate individual units in a cluster) है।

questions.question: Which agricultural system involves farmers pooling their land, livestock, and labor to work collectively, while retaining small plots for personal use?
In July 2025, the United States of America concluded a historic trade deal with which of the following major economic partners?
Which of the following committees recommended the division of rights into justiciable and non-justiciable categories in India?
In which part of the Constitution of India are the Constitutional provisions related to municipalities discussed?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Part IX A) है।

questions.question: What was the primary economic objective of British colonial rule in India?
options: To modernize Indian agriculture by introducing scientific techniques
To establish industrial hubs across Indian provinces to encourage local manufacturing growth
To transform India into a supplier of raw materials and a market for British goods
To promote Indian handicrafts and traditional industries through access to international markets
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (To transform India into a supplier of raw materials and a market for British goods) है।

questions.question: Which dance is characterised stylistically by its footwork and pirouettes and is pre-eminently a dance of rhythm-play?
Which of the following Indian legal codes requires trial courts to refer all death penalty cases to the jurisdictional High Court for confirmation?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973) है।

questions.question: The nation's first AI-powered Anganwadi center, a pilot project under Mission Bal Bharari, was inaugurated in which state ?
Which Article of the Constitution of India empowers the Parliament to provide for the establishment of administrative tribunals?

In June 2025, which of the following institutions signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) to reduce road dust pollution in the National Capital Region (NCR)?
options: CSIR–Central Road Research Institute (CSIR–CRRI) and School of Planning and Architecture (SPA), New Delhi
NITI Aayog and Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru
Ministry of Road Transport and CSIR–National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR–NEERI)
CSIR–National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR–NEERI) and Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Delhi
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (CSIR–Central Road Research Institute (CSIR–CRRI) and School of Planning and Architecture (SPA), New Delhi) है।

questions.question: Pata Naach of _______ is the folk dance of the Kurmi and Santhal tribes.
Who collaborated with Venkat Raman Singh Shyam to write ‘Finding My Way’?
Jamsetji Nusserwanji Tata founded the Tata Group in the year _____________.
Which of the following is defined as the change in output per unit of change in the input when all other inputs are held constant?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Marginal product of an input) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of globalisation?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Stronger national borders) है।

questions.question: सल्तनत काल में मनाया जाने वाला नवरोज़ (Nowruz)______ का नव वर्ष था।
भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद में उल्लेख है कि प्रधानमंत्री के नेतृत्व में मंत्रिपरिषद राष्ट्रपति के कार्यों में सहायता करने के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
